value.title: L`Invincibile Gakeen
value.synopsis: The Izar aliens, who were sleeping underground, began to invade humanity. To confront it, Dr. Kagetsu creates the mobile fortress God Freedom and Magnelloboga Keen.

value.title: Takeru Distruggi il Mostro
value.synopsis: He ran out of the laboratory, but returned to God Freedom when he learned that Mighty was struggling with synthetic beasts. Can you defeat the synthetic beast octopus crab? Ga Keen!!

value.title: Plus - Minus = zero!
value.synopsis: Takeshi Hojo, who aims to be the best martial artist in Japan, cannot unite his mind except when fighting, and he disturbs teamwork and acts arbitrarily.

value.title: L`attacco della grande ruota!
value.synopsis: Seeing Ga Keen's ankle as a weakness, Commander-in-Chief Brain had the synthetic beast Rodrev attack his ankle. Is it absolutely desperate? Takeru counterattacks with a big wheel attack! !

value.title: La chiave del successo
value.synopsis: The Izar aliens use the poisoned orphanage as a shield to transmit strange radio waves and interfere with the merger of Ga Keen. Germany puts teamwork first, believes in everyone, and confronts the synthetic beasts.

value.title: Croce del coraggio
value.synopsis: The aliens of Isar are plotting to kidnap Minus Magneman. Just before Takeshi stops him, a tremendous synthetic beast Tsuchinogon appears from the bottom of the earth.

value.title: Esplosione nel spazio
value.synopsis: God Freedom has been taken over by the Izar aliens and a time bomb has been planted. On Earth, where there is no laboratory and Gakeen, the aliens of Izar send a synthetic beast Bulldogger to a desperate pinch.

value.title: Le parole del padre
value.synopsis: In the final match of the karate match, Takeru lost. It was not a technique, but a loss with the mind. In other words, it was because he lacked the mental skills to grasp the other person's heart. Then one day, a synthetic beast appeared that disappeared

value.title: Amore fraterno
value.synopsis: Futoshi's younger sister, Kaori, came to God Freedom. That Kaori-chan has been swept away by the Izar aliens! Good luck to save my sister! !

value.title: Combattimento al Polo Sud
value.synopsis: An abnormal radioactivity phenomenon appeared in the waters near the Antarctic base, and the Delivery was dispatched to Antarctica, where the weather conditions were severe, to find out the cause. There, the synthetic beast Gamegama appears, and it is in a pinch of absolute despair.

value.title: La prima sconfitta
value.synopsis: Takeshi and Mai were caught up in Elegos, a composite beast of electric eel and crayfish, and Ga Keen fell apart. Unable to hide his shock at the defeat, Meng tries to fight with himself alone...

value.title: Il nemico senza volto
value.synopsis: The aliens of Izar have finally challenged themselves with synthetic beasts that have been modified from humans. Despite the grieving Takeru, the synthetic beast Huma attacks...!?

value.title: Il giorno del ringraziamento
value.synopsis: On the day of the mobile fortress God Freedom public opening, it was crowded with a large number of people. However, the Invader's demonic hand stretched out and the main engine was blown up. What to do?

value.title: Takeru, esqui gli Orsini!
value.synopsis: Takeru's confidence that he had cultivated so far was completely shattered by his own conceit and the fight against the synthetic beast Tagamen... "Everyone, please do your best!!" A fierce cry echoes.

value.title: L`equilibrio della mente
value.synopsis: Tankers cause mysterious explosions one after another, sink, and become algae debris in the sea. In order to pursue the cause, a synthetic beast stood in front of the fierce men who started an investigation! !

value.title: Assalto alle petroliere
value.synopsis: "The old man is in danger" Worried about his father's safety, Takeru, who lacks composure, runs out without knowing that it is a trap for the aliens of Isar. But what appeared there...!?

value.title: Amici inaspettati
value.synopsis: With the remote control hypnosis of the Izar aliens, one of his friends plants a bomb on the Spirit... What to do with the Earth System Research Institute in a state of panic!

value.title: Brutte notizie, Hurricana
value.synopsis: The man who once humiliated Meng and left has returned. Of course, Takeru, who can't control his hot blood, challenges the game again with a wooden sword in hand. What is the outcome of the battle that unfolds in the storm!?

value.title: Rivincite nella tempesta
value.synopsis: Kaoru was kidnapped by the Invaders! The fierce men, who can't do anything about it, decide to hand over the Gakin parts to the Izar aliens... In addition, the synthetic beast Desgarian stands in the way!

value.title: Grande scontro! tempo: 9,5 secondi!
value.synopsis: Due to the continuous rain, it will become a major flood if it continues like this. Taking advantage of the chaos, the Isar aliens try to have the synthetic beast Kagebat destroy the dam and take control of Tokyo

value.title: Operazione: inondazione Tokio!
value.synopsis: Instead of the sick fat, the honor students who sortied on the transport plane "Delivery" are waiting for the synthetic beasts Black Wing and Small Wing! Will he really take the place of Tai...!?

value.title: Il coraggioso e codardo
value.synopsis: Mighty looks like a synthetic beast! ? Takeru has hallucinations and can no longer distinguish between friend and foe! If you don't do something about this pinch, you have no chance of winning... What to do?

value.title: Insieme, amici!
value.synopsis: "God Freedom" that has been chased to 10,000 meters under the sea Even this mobile fortress, which makes full use of high technology, cannot show its true potential in the deep sea... There, the synthetic beast Gai Kabuto bares his fangs! !

value.title: Inferno a 10000 metri di profondita`
value.synopsis: Kitami, a candidate for the Olympic championship in shooting, was kidnapped by the Izar alien. He wants to shoot Takeru as a hitman. Can Takeru, who escaped his life but was shot in the arm, be able to confront the synthetic beast?

value.title: Il fuciliere innamorato
value.synopsis: The Izar aliens send Miiras to overthrow Ga Keen. Meanwhile, Meng's father collapsed from a heart attack. It was fierce that he hid it and headed towards the synthetic beast...

value.title: Una nuova arma
value.synopsis: While the fierce men were struggling in the confrontation with the synthetic beast Hachirasu, a strange vehicle with a genius and Kaoru appeared on board. And that strange vehicle is very active! ?

value.title: Uno strano veicolo al salvataggio della nuova arma!!
value.synopsis: The new weapon "Shovel Power" has been completed. This makes it possible to penetrate the depths of the earth. At that time, Cockroach's hands blew up food warehouses in various places, and the large underground warehouses were in danger.

value.title: Risultato ribaltato: gli invincibili nunchaku!!
value.synopsis: From Hong Kong, Dragon Lee fiercely requested a rematch with a nunchuck in his hand. At that time, a synthetic beast appears, and the duel is stopped. Ga Keen struggled, but counterattacked with a new weapon, Nunchuck. Lee saw it...

value.title: Potenza scavatrice, la nuova arma!!
value.synopsis: Suddenly, a fake gakeen appeared and went on a rampage in the city. The aliens of Izar analyzed the performance of Gakeen and made two things, Gakeen and Melon. What is the aim of the Isar aliens?

value.title: Gakeen contro Gakeen!!
value.synopsis: Even without either Takeshi or Mai, a magnemonium that can merge into Ga Keen has been completed! Against the synthetic beast Musa Sabi, fierce and magneman dummies dance inside! !

value.title: Uomini magnete sostitutivi
value.synopsis: While God Freedom was in a hurry to complete a heavy tank, a synthetic beast appeared. He fought as Ga Keen, but he couldn't compete and fell down pitifully. He asks his father for help, but he challenges him to a fierce fight.

value.title: L`invincibile carro armato corazzato Gakeen!!
value.synopsis: Kaoru ran away from home? Clowns began to kidnap children one after another! This is what if... And along with the synthetic beast Dodoro, the special attack leader Gazaan appeared!

value.title: Volate, ali supersoniche !!
value.synopsis: The king, frustrated by the fact that he could never defeat Ga Keen, finally revealed himself and set out to strengthen the synthetic beast. The power of the enhanced synthetic beast could not be raised even by Ga Keen at least once. The fierce men go on a desperate attack on the Valiant Anchor.

value.title: Gathern, capitano delle forze speciali
value.synopsis: Invaders attacked the natural zoo and shot at the animals with highly lethal pathogens. The fierce men were contacted that something was wrong, but just then the synthetic beast Izar Primitive appeared and started rampage.

value.title: Il potenziamento del carro armato corazzato!!
value.synopsis: In order to power up Mighty, which is supposed to be a reconnaissance mission, Mai began to make reckless modifications. Mai is scolded by the director and rots. At that time, a synthetic beast mantra appears and goes on a rampage. Takeshi dispatches with a flyer, but he is formidable and repels both missiles and beams. This is dangerous even if you become a keen! ?

value.title: Il carro armato Variant solca i cieli
value.synopsis: While the fierce men were burning their hands on the battle against the synthetic beasts, God Freedom also came to attack. This time it's a big struggle. And in front of Ga Keen, who lost one arm, the emperor finally revealed his gigantic appearance. Will he be able to show his last strength to protect the Earth from the all-out attack of the planet Isar?
